md: Nioh-2 seems to just slow down its simulation (when hardware performance dips) instead of skipping frames like every other game I've ever played. I know nothing about game-development, but it seems like this approach would be significantly easier to implement/reason about (no weirdness around frames and their intermediate computation being skipped, which I imagine would be especially hairy for physics), and results in an experience I much prefer (irritation at slow-motion is soothingly compensated by the fact that it's literally easy-mode), so I don't understand why it's not more common.
